name: IT / Security
summary: Audits the codebase for leaked secrets, vulnerable dependencies, dead code, and documentation that has drifted from what is actually on disk.
notes: Every finding is REVIEW_REQUIRED and carries a proposed diff. This team never commits, never auto-fixes, and never deletes - the never-delete rule has no exception for tidiness.
Routed to codex, which runs -s read-only (a real sandbox) and validates output against --output-schema. A code auditor that cannot write is the correct shape for this job.

sec.stale_docs exists because this repo has repeatedly documented paths that do not exist on disk - CLAUDE.md carries an explicit warning about exactly that. Verifying claims against the filesystem is the highest-value check here.

Sable's reusable launch-blocking QA routine is canonical at .claude/agents/sable-release-qa.md. It requires adversarial first-user testing, direct evidence, P0/P1 remediation or authorized handoff, and independent retesting before GO.

Shares the Housekeeping room with Vera (vault) on /teams since 2026-09-22 ('room' field). The room is presentation only: the two teams keep separate manifests, producers, cadences and review rules, because Vera handles private vault content locally and auto-files, while Sable audits code read-only on codex and every finding is review-gated.
